purpose: Representative non-Bible safety dry-run against exact production audio and edition text

results.reason: Observed alignment below 85% for paragraphs containing printed numeric enumeration
results.diagnosis: The text contains 1/2/3/4/5 while Whisper reports one/two/three/four/five; the aligner's normalization does not yet treat those as equivalent. The audio itself matches semantically. No sidecar was emitted.

results.reason: Observed alignment below 85% for one paragraph containing printed numeric enumeration
results.diagnosis: The text contains 1/2/3/4/5 while Whisper reports one/two/three/four/five. No sidecar was emitted.

results.reason: Several speaker-label paragraphs fell below the 85% observed-match gate
results.diagnosis: Legacy production TTS spelled uppercase speaker labels letter by letter, so the audio is not a literal reading of the current displayed token. This requires a documented label-equivalence rule or replacement audio; lowering the quality threshold would be unsafe. No sidecar was emitted.
